chapter_title: Chương 10: 0010【Phạt Đứng? Không Ai Được Thiếu】

segments.title: Chương 10: 0010【Phạt Đứng? Không Ai Được Thiếu】
segments.content:
The next day.

Chen Guiliang woke up early and ran to the cafeteria for meat buns.

Three straight days of full meals, with meat at every one, made Chen Guiliang feel full of energy.

Even his sunken cheeks seemed to be filling out.

After filling his stomach, Chen Guiliang went to the classroom, took out his geography textbook, and started reviewing.

He wasn't confident about getting a guaranteed admission spot, so he still had to study what needed studying.

History, geography, and politics were the easiest. He still vaguely remembered the basic knowledge points and just needed to brush up on the parts he had forgotten.

No one supervised the morning self-study session, but two-thirds of the boarding students in the class came to the classroom on their own to study.

As class time approached, more and more students arrived.

Bian Guanyue and Zheng Feng walked into the classroom one after the other.

Zheng Feng was a crafty one. Taking advantage of the fact that he lived near Bian Guanyue, he had specifically woken up early today to walk one bus stop. He then waited patiently at the stop where Bian Guanyue was likely to get on, pretending to read a book.

One bus after another went by, but Zheng Feng didn't get on.

After waiting for a full forty minutes, he finally saw Bian Guanyue appear, and his wish to ride the same bus as the beauty was granted.

But the countless lines Zheng Feng had prepared all went unsaid due to his nervousness.

Their entire conversation was as follows:

"Morning, Classmate Bian."

"Morning."

"What a coincidence, you get on here too."

"Mmm."

"Have you eaten breakfast?"

Bian Guanyue closed her eyes and pretended to nap, not speaking again until they got off the bus.

After getting off, there was still no communication.

Zheng Feng could only follow silently, pretending to be walking alongside the beauty. But this was enough to satisfy him. He felt like many boys were casting envious glances at him on the way to the classroom.

This wonderful delusion grew even stronger when he entered the classroom with Bian Guanyue.

It seemed like the whole class was looking at him!

Bian Guanyue stuffed her schoolbag into her desk and sat down, waiting quietly for class to start.

"Morning."

Chen Guiliang didn't look up, continuing to review his geography, and just offered a polite greeting.

"Morning."

Bian Guanyue replied nonchalantly.

She had an excellent impression of Chen Guiliang. Aside from teasing Li Jun last night, it was mainly because Chen Guiliang wasn't annoying.

Li Jun and Zheng Feng, on the other hand, she found quite annoying.

After waiting for a while before class officially started, Bian Guanyue took the initiative to speak, "Where in the county can I buy a bicycle?"

"I don't know." Chen Guiliang genuinely had no idea.

After both Chen Guiliang and Bian Guanyue had changed seats, Zheng Feng was now in the adjacent seat in the row in front of them. He pricked up his ears and managed to overhear their conversation.

Zheng Feng scurried over in a few steps. "Classmate Bian, are you looking to buy a bicycle? I know where they sell them. Actually, I was thinking of buying one too. We could ride to and from school together."

Bian Guanyue's attitude was cold. "No, thank you."

"I..."

Zheng Feng wanted to say more but held his tongue.

The words had fallen flat, and there was no picking them back up.

The Chinese teacher walked into the classroom, and the whole class quickly quieted down.

Only then did Chen Guiliang put away his geography book and say to Bian Guanyue, "I'll ask around for you."

Bian Guanyue said, "Thank you."

Zheng Feng had been eavesdropping the whole time and now felt terrible.

He was so handsome, could he really not compare to Chen Guiliang?

Although Chen Guiliang was 1.8 meters tall, he was as thin as a bamboo pole. His face had no flesh on it, his sunken cheeks making him look like a skeleton.

Besides, his own grades weren't much worse than Chen Guiliang's. In fact, he had surpassed him in the recent midterm exam.

Why was Bian Guanyue ignoring him but willing to accept Chen Guiliang's help?

He couldn't figure it out!

The Chinese teacher was named Li Runze. He was over fifty and a master teacher.

He never lost his temper and had a rather Zen-like demeanor.

Li Runze didn't call out names one by one to hand out the tests. He walked to the lectern and called out, "Class representative, pass out the midterm papers."

Chen Guiliang was the Chinese class representative.

While Chen Guiliang was handing out the papers, Li Runze unhurriedly opened his thermos, blew at the floating tea leaves for a good while, didn't take a sip, and then screwed the lid back on.

After Chen Guiliang finished handing out the papers, he couldn't find his own.

Li Runze took out one paper and said with a smile, "In this midterm exam, Chen Guiliang is first in Chinese again. He lost 3 points on reading comprehension and 2 points on the essay, for a total score of 145."

"Wow!"

The students gasped in amazement.

Only Li Jun showed a look of disdain, muttering, "What's the damn use of being good at Chinese."

Li Runze didn't rush to go over the midterm questions. Instead, he held up the paper and said, "Chen Guiliang's essay is exceptionally well-written. I'll read it as a model essay, then break it down section by section to explain why it received such a high score..."

Chen Guiliang had been reborn during the math exam, so the Chinese exam was already over.

At this moment, listening to his own high school essay, he didn't feel much pride or self-satisfaction.

Rather, it was awkward...

It was so damn cringey. The whole piece was just him forcing melancholy for the sake of new verses.

How to describe this awkwardness? It was like being middle-aged and looking back at your old QQ space.

Oh, for crying out loud!

Li Runze read the essay once, then began to analyze and appreciate it in detail. "This time, the essay topic was 'Love,' with no title restrictions. Some students wrote about family, some wrote about friendship, and some wrote about romantic love."

"Family, friendship, and romantic love are all different expressions of love. But Chen Guiliang has gone beyond these forms to directly explore the essence of love. Especially the ending, which adapts a line from Li Yu's poetry to 'Love is like the spring grass, the farther one goes, the more it grows.' They say an essay should have a phoenix head, a pig's belly, and a leopard's tail. This is the leopard's tail. It's concise, powerful, beautiful, and timeless, leaving one with endless things to ponder..."

"The concept of this piece is already a level above ordinary essays, and it cleverly incorporates six allusions. Using allusions is also a bonus, but they can't be used randomly. Some students didn't do this well..."

Chen Guiliang didn't care anymore. As long as he wasn't embarrassed, it was others who would be.

And surprisingly, no one seemed embarrassed. The students were all listening with rapt attention.

Especially the students with good grades, who hoped to improve their own future essay scores by studying Chen Guiliang's model essay.

Bian Guanyue couldn't help but steal a glance at Chen Guiliang.

This new deskmate was such a good writer. No wonder she'd heard last night that he was going to participate in the New Concept Writing Competition.

For the entire Chinese class, the teacher talked only about the essay. Using Chen Guiliang's essay as a model, he deconstructed it sentence by sentence, explaining in detail the techniques of writing.

"There are only a few minutes left before class ends."

Li Runze glanced at his watch. "Carefully consider what I've just said. To improve your essay scores, there's nothing more than to read more and write more. Reading ten thousand books breaks them down, and the pen moves as if guided by spirits. This is a timeless truth. Chen Guiliang has done very well in this regard, even saving his meal money to buy many extracurricular books to read."

Xu Haibo suddenly raised his hand. "Teacher, Chen Guiliang submitted to the New Concept competition this year!"

"Oh?"

Li Runze immediately smiled and nodded. "Participating in New Concept is also excellent. Winning a first prize can get you a guaranteed admission spot."

Xu Haibo held up the "Crusade Against Mei" treatise high, presenting it like a treasure. "Chen Guiliang's preliminary round essay is exceptionally well-written. I even made a special copy of it."

"Bring it over for me to see," Li Runze said.

Xu Haibo trotted over and handed him the essay.

The more Li Runze read, the more he liked it, lavishing praise without restraint. "Classmate Chen Guiliang's writing is becoming more and more sophisticated. The depth of his thinking has already surpassed most high school students. Let me read this article to everyone..."

Again!

Fortunately, this treatise wasn't childish.

The bell finally rang, and Li Runze left with his thermos.

It was Monday. Because the different grade levels were taking their midterm exams on a rotating basis, there were no morning exercises or flag-raising ceremony.

Chen Guiliang's Chinese test paper was passed around eagerly among the top students in the front rows.

This special honor didn't last long. Next up was math class.

The math teacher was named Lin Song.

While handing out the papers, Lin Song's face was grim. "Some students have an extremely poor attitude, leaving everything blank except for the multiple-choice questions! If it was because you couldn't solve the problems, I wouldn't be this angry. But he knows how to do them. He only got one multiple-choice question wrong!"

I only got one multiple-choice and one fill-in-the-blank wrong on the gaokao, and my total score was...

Chen Guiliang lamented inwardly: Teacher, I really don't know how.

"Chen Guiliang, stand up for me!"

Lin Song's tone was extremely severe.

Chen Guiliang, who had just been repeatedly praised by the Chinese teacher, now once again became the focus of the entire class.

Bian Guanyue was also very curious. The contrast was just too great.

Lin Song asked, "Why did you only do the multiple-choice questions?"

Chen Guiliang said, "I had a stomachache."

"Nonsense!"

Lin Song exposed him on the spot. "Someone saw you turn in your paper early and then go to the notice board to set up a stall selling books."

Li Jun was smug. He was the one who had snitched.

A few minutes earlier, Li Jun had been waiting in the hallway specifically for the math teacher to appear.

He wanted revenge for losing face last night.

After scolding him for a bit, Lin Song, still fuming, said, "Take your paper and stand there and listen attentively to the class!"

Chen Guiliang sighed helplessly. He'd been reborn, yet he still had to stand for punishment.

The teacher began to go over the math test. Li Jun tilted his head, winking and making faces at Chen Guiliang. He even secretly flipped him the middle finger, mouthing "idiot" at him.

"Teacher Lin." Chen Guiliang believed in immediate payback.

Lin Song said impatiently, "What is it?"

"Li Jun is distracting me from class, and he's making this gesture." Chen Guiliang made a circle with his left thumb and index finger, then stuck the middle finger of his right hand into the circle and thrust it back and forth.

This gesture, of course, represented the piston movement.

Li Jun quickly denied it. "Teacher, I didn't."

"You did."

"I didn't."

"You did."

"I didn't."

"..."

Lin Song grew annoyed by the bickering and finally said, "Stop arguing. Li Jun, you stand and listen to the class too."

"Why? He's slandering me!" Li Jun slammed his desk in anger.

Lin Song already disliked misbehaving students like Li Jun. Seeing him dare to slam the desk and talk back, he finally lost his temper too. "Stand up, and no talking! If you dare disrupt the class again, I'll talk to your parents at the parent-teacher conference this weekend."

Li Jun stood up resentfully, glaring viciously at Chen Guiliang.

Chen Guiliang returned a smile.

A few minutes later, the more Li Jun thought about it, the angrier he got. He suddenly thought of a target to vent on.

Li Jun called out, "Teacher."

Lin Song's brow furrowed. "What now?"

Li Jun pointed at his deskmate. "Guan Zhiqiang is reading a novel. He's not listening to you go over the test."

Guan Zhiqiang was completely bewildered: What does your fight have to do with me?

Lin Song said, "Guan Zhiqiang, you stand and listen too."

Guan Zhiqiang, an innocent bystander caught in the crossfire, stood up listlessly. He really wanted to beat Li Jun up.

Li Jun, however, had a smile on his face, feeling inexplicably much better.

Bian Guanyue looked from side to side, observing the "three phantoms" standing and listening. She felt that this class seemed quite interesting.

(Continuing the sacrifice, stripping away their luck to forge my golden body. This book belongs to a fellow reader: 2002: Starting from an Online Romance with a Rich and Pretty Girl)
